definition_and_formula: Total gold benchmark entity pair evaluations (N = 100)
Actual duplicate or alias pairs in gold truth (TP + FN)
Actual distinct corporate entity pairs in gold truth (TN + FP)
Correctly resolved matching entity pairs (auto-merged with valid statutory ID)
Fatal False Merge: Distinct legal entities erroneously merged (0 in V2!)
Distinct entities correctly kept separate or routed to manual review
Non-fatal Missed Link: True matches routed to manual review due to missing statutory ID
-ln(0.05) / 0.001: Minimum negative trials needed to bound FPR < 0.1% at 95% CI
